preconditions.description: The length of the happy string n must be between 1 and 10.
The index k must be between 1 and 100.

postconditions.expression: stdout in ['a', 'b', 'c'] if n == 1 else len(stdout) == n and all(stdout[i] != stdout[i + 1] for i in range(n - 1))
postconditions.description: The output must be a happy string of length n if n is 1, or a valid happy string of length n with no consecutive identical characters.
If k exceeds the number of possible happy strings of length n, the output must be an empty string.
